avere fame.note: Removed fare: fare la fame is an idiom (to starve).

avere torto.note: Removed fare: fare torto a qualcuno is standard.

avere paura.note: Removed prendere (prendere paura is common) and tenere (regional southern use, said by natives); added stare.

avere bisogno.note: Removed fare: far bisogno exists (literary, 'to be necessary').

avere voglia.note: Removed tenere (regional southern tenere for avere is said by natives).

avere fretta.note: Removed tenere (regional southern tenere for avere).

avere caldo.note: Could not name three safe wrong collocates: prendere caldo is said (ho preso caldo), tenere caldo and stare caldi are valid, fare caldo is valid.

avere freddo.note: Replaced tenere (regional, and tenere freddo/in freddo exists) with stare.

avere sonno.note: Removed prendere: prendere sonno is standard (to fall asleep); added stare.

prendere freddo.note: All three wrong collocates form standard phrases (avere freddo, fare freddo, essere freddo); a gap-fill would have several correct answers. The English gloss was also garbled.

fare una foto.note: Removed mettere: mettere una foto (post a photo) is normal.

dare un esame.note: Removed tenere: tenere un esame is said of the examiner.

fare una pausa.note: The calque prendere is acceptable Italian (prendere / prendersi una pausa), so it would be marked wrong although correct.

fare la doccia.note: Not certain that prendere una doccia is unacceptable (dictionaries record it, and prendere una doccia fredda is standard); remaining distractors are only literal readings (avere/mettere la doccia).

fare un bagno.note: prendere un bagno is recorded as standard next to fare un bagno, so the calque is a correct answer.

fare un favore.note: Removed calque: English 'do a favour' maps to fare; dare is not an English calque (kept as a wrong collocate).

fare una telefonata.note: Removed prendere: prendere una telefonata (take a call) is said; replaced with chiamare. No English calque differs from fare, so calque removed.

fare una promessa.note: Removed calque: English 'make a promise' maps to fare; dare is not an English calque (kept as wrong).

dare una mano.note: prestare una mano and offrire una mano are both attested for 'help'; not certain they are wrong, and no three safe distractors.

dare un passaggio.note: fare un passaggio is standard Italian (a pass, in sport) and prendere un passaggio is used by the passenger; 'fare' is not an English calque of 'give a lift'.

fare male.note: ferire male ('wound badly') and mettersi male are valid; male is not a clear noun node here; the pair does not work as a collocation drill.

dire una bugia.note: Removed calque: fare is not what English 'tell a lie' gives (kept as wrong).

risolvere un problema.note: Removed fare (fare un problema di matematica is normal) and aprire; calque is now aggiustare (English 'fix a problem').

prendere il sole.note: Removed calque: fare is not an English calque of 'sunbathe' (kept as wrong).

perdere la pazienza.note: Removed calque: English 'lose' maps to perdere; lasciare is not a calque (kept as wrong).

mandare un messaggio.note: dare un messaggio (deliver / send out a message), mettere un messaggio (post) and colloquial fare un messaggio are all said; no safe distractors.

spegnere la luce.note: Removed togliere: togliere la luce is standard (to cut the power); added smettere.

passare il tempo.note: spendere il tempo is recorded in Italian dictionaries (spendere il tempo, le energie) and usare il tempo is normal; the calque is acceptable.

risparmiare tempo.note: Removed mettere: metterci tempo is standard.

vento forte.note: Calque corrected: the English calque is alto (high wind), not pesante; alto moved first.

odore forte.note: odore pesante is normal Italian and odore potente is acceptable; English 'strong' gives forte, so there is no calque either.

pressione alta.note: Removed forte (forte pressione is normal Italian); calque removed, English 'high' maps to alta.

prezzo alto.note: Removed forte (prezzo forte is attested); calque removed, English 'high' maps to alto.

pasto leggero.note: Removed magro (pasto magro / mangiare di magro is Italian); calque chiaro moved first.

dormire profondamente.note: Removed pesantemente: dormire pesantemente is attested Italian; calque removed.

profondamente addormentato.note: Removed pesantemente: attested with addormentato; calque removed.
